ban.title: Access blocked
ban.text: This site's security system blocked your connection because it looked like an attack. If that's a mistake, contact the site owner with the details below.
ban.witty: Our bouncer says your name is not on the list.
captcha.title: Quick check
captcha.text: Your connection looked a little unusual. Solve the check below to continue to the site.
captcha.witty: Just making sure you're not a very polite robot.
upstream_error.title: Site unavailable
upstream_error.text: The proxy is working, but the server behind it did not answer. Try again in a moment; if it keeps happening, let the site owner know.
upstream_error.witty: The server behind this site seems to be taking a nap.
denied.title: Access denied
denied.text: You don't have permission to open this page. If you think you should, ask the site owner for access.
denied.witty: This door needs a key you don't have yet.
not_found.title: Page not found
not_found.text: There is nothing at this address. Check the link, or go back to where you came from.
not_found.witty: We looked everywhere, even under the couch.
maintenance.title: Back soon
maintenance.text: This site is down for planned maintenance. Please try again a little later.
maintenance.witty: Tightening a few screws, back in a moment.
certificate.title: Secure connection unavailable
certificate.text: This site's security certificate could not be renewed or is missing, so it can't be reached securely right now. The site owner needs to renew it.
certificate.witty: Our padlock is out for repairs.
default_site.title: NPMpro is running
default_site.text: This address points at an NPMpro server, but no site is set up for it yet. If you are the owner, add a host in the admin UI.
default_site.witty: A fresh start, waiting for its first site.
